notes.notes: New features in this update include The mimic goblin who will be found in any normal room having a large some of coins but wont stay around for long so kill him quick, The new settings include a custom crosshair select from your computer any png file to upload as a crosshair you may also decide its scale in game as well as if it spins like the normal one does, You can now chat with both the shop keep and the witch.
